literal: seventh month · the star Antares · flows west

meaning.en: In the seventh lunar month the star Antares (大火) moves west, signalling that the heat is fading and autumn is coming.
meaning.zh: 农历七月，大火星向西落下，天气开始转凉。

examples.zh: 七月流火，早晚已有凉意，该添件外套了。
examples.en: With the seventh month's 'falling fire', mornings and evenings are cool; time for a jacket.

examples.zh: “七月流火”提醒人们，酷暑将尽，秋天快到了。
examples.en: 'Seventh-month fire flows' reminds us that the fierce heat is ending and autumn is near.

story.en: The Book of Songs line describes the farming year: when Antares sinks westward in the seventh month, it is time to prepare winter clothes in the ninth.

usage.en: Classic misuse trap: many people use it to mean scorching heat, but it says the opposite: the weather is turning cooler. Say 酷暑难耐 for fierce heat.
usage.zh: 常见误用：不少人把它当作“天气酷热”，其实指天气转凉。形容酷热应说“酷暑难耐”“赤日炎炎”。

meaning.en: To speak honestly and act uprightly, even under pressure.
meaning.zh: 说话正直，行事正派。

examples.zh: 他一生危言危行，从不阿谀权贵。
examples.en: All his life he spoke and acted with integrity and never fawned on the powerful.

examples.zh: 身处乱世，仍能危言危行，实属难得。
examples.en: To remain upright in word and deed in turbulent times is rare.

story.en: Confucius said: when the Way prevails in the state, speak and act uprightly; when it does not, act uprightly but speak with caution.
story.zh: 《论语》：“邦有道，危言危行；邦无道，危行言孙。”

usage.en: Praise. Do not confuse with 危言耸听 (scaremongering): here 危 means 'upright', not 'dangerous'.
usage.zh: 褒义。注意不要与“危言耸听”混淆：这里的“危”是“正直”，不是“危险”。

natural: hit the nail on the head

meaning.en: To hit the crux of a matter exactly; to make a point that is right on target.
meaning.zh: 比喻说话、做事击中要害，抓住关键。

equivalents: hit the nail on the head
get to the heart of the matter

examples.zh: 他的分析切中肯綮，一语道破问题根源。
examples.en: His analysis hit the nail on the head and exposed the root of the problem in a sentence.

examples.zh: 这篇评论切中肯綮，值得决策者参考。
examples.en: This commentary gets to the heart of the matter and deserves the attention of decision-makers.

story.en: Cook Ding carves an ox so skilfully that his knife never touches the tendons and joints (肯綮); the story illustrates following the natural grain of things.
story.zh: 《庄子》：“技经肯綮之未尝，而况大軱乎！”

usage.en: Praise for remarks, criticism or analysis. Note the pronunciation 切 qiè (fit closely) and 肯綮 kěn qìng (joint where tendon meets bone); not a place to use for physical hits.
usage.zh: 褒义，多形容评论、分析。“切”读 qiè，“綮”读 qìng，“肯綮”指筋骨结合处。

meaning.en: To be in no way inferior to others; to be just as good or just as bold.
meaning.zh: 在某方面毫不谦让，指不比别人差，可以相提并论。

examples.zh: 论实力，这支新军不遑多让，足以与老牌强队抗衡。
examples.en: In strength this newcomer is second to none and can take on the established teams.

examples.zh: 他的画技不遑多让，比起名家毫不逊色。
examples.en: His painting skill is every bit as good as the masters'.

usage.en: Usually 'X 不遑多让' or 'X 比…不遑多让' to say someone matches or rivals another. It is not about being unwilling to give way in a polite sense; 遑 means 'leisure', so 不遑 = 'no time to'.
usage.zh: 多用于“比较后不逊色”。“遑”是“闲暇”，“不遑”即来不及，不是“不退让”的字面意思。

meaning.en: A polite reply to praise: I feel too unworthy to accept it.
meaning.zh: 感到惭愧，不敢承受（别人的夸奖或礼遇），多作谦辞。

examples.zh: 您过奖了，我愧不敢当。
examples.en: You flatter me; I really don't deserve it.

examples.zh: 获此殊荣，愧不敢当，今后一定更加努力。
examples.en: I feel unworthy of this honour and will work harder from now on.

usage.en: Humble expression for responding to compliments, rewards or titles about oneself; not for describing others.
usage.zh: 谦辞，用于回应别人对自己的赞誉或礼遇，不能用于他人。

literal: pass through · long time · ever more · fresh

meaning.en: To stay fresh and valuable, or even grow more so, as time passes.
meaning.zh: 经历很长时间，不但不衰减，反而更加鲜明、有活力。

examples.zh: 经典作品历久弥新，一代代读者都爱不释手。
examples.en: Classics stay fresh with time; generation after generation of readers cannot put them down.

examples.zh: 这份友谊历久弥新。
examples.en: This friendship has only grown stronger with the years.

usage.en: Praise for works, traditions, friendships or brands. 弥 means 'more'. Not used for things that merely last long but are old and worn.
usage.zh: 褒义，多形容作品、传统、友谊、品牌等。“弥”是“更加”。

literal: disgracefully · be ranked in · gate · wall
natural: I'm unworthy to be your disciple

meaning.en: A humble way to say one has the honour of being in a teacher's school despite being unworthy.
meaning.zh: 谦辞，自称有愧地列入师门，作为某人的学生。

equivalents: unworthy though I am, I count myself your pupil
have the honour to be a student of

examples.zh: 晚辈忝列门墙，多年来蒙先生教诲。
examples.en: Unworthy as I am, I am your pupil and have been taught by you for years.

examples.zh: 他在寿宴上说：“学生忝列门墙三十载，不敢忘师恩。”
examples.en: At the birthday banquet he said, 'I have had the honour of being your pupil for thirty years and have never forgotten your kindness.'

usage.en: Trap: a humble term only for oneself, about being a disciple of a teacher. Never use it to describe someone else's relationship with a teacher.
usage.zh: 常见误用：这是谦辞，只能用于自己，不能用来说别人。

meaning.en: A polite greeting on first meeting someone: I have long admired your reputation.
meaning.zh: 初次见面的客套话，表示早就听说过对方的名声，很仰慕。

equivalents: I've heard so much about you

examples.zh: 李教授，久仰大名，今日终于见到您了。
examples.en: Professor Li, I've long heard of you; I'm delighted to finally meet you.

examples.zh: “久仰大名！”两位企业家握手寒暄。
examples.en: 'I've heard so much about you!' the two entrepreneurs said as they shook hands.

usage.en: Trap: only for meeting someone for the first time. It is wrong to use it with people you already know. Often paired with 幸会幸会.
usage.zh: 常见误用：只用于初次见面，熟人之间不能用。常与“幸会幸会”连用。

literal: auspicious beast's · fur · a piece of · feather

meaning.en: A surviving fragment of something precious, especially an old relic, painting or writing.
meaning.zh: 神兽的一片毛皮，比喻残存的珍贵文物或文字。

examples.zh: 这几页残稿是先生留下的吉光片羽，弥足珍贵。
examples.en: These few leaves are all that remains of the master's manuscript, and they are priceless.

examples.zh: 博物馆里陈列的残简，都是千年前的吉光片羽。
examples.en: The fragments of bamboo slips on display are precious scraps from a thousand years ago.

usage.en: Trap: refers to rare, valuable remnants of old art or writing, not to any small quantity of things. Also 片羽吉光 (rare).
usage.zh: 常见误用：指残存的珍贵文物、字画或文章，不能泛指少量普通物品。

meaning.en: To talk in an engaging, unhurried way that people enjoy listening to.
meaning.zh: 形容说话生动，连续不倦，让人爱听。

examples.zh: 老人坐在炉边，娓娓而谈当年的往事。
examples.en: The old man sat by the stove and talked fondly of the past.

examples.zh: 她娓娓而谈，听众都入了迷。
examples.en: She spoke so charmingly that the audience was spellbound.

usage.en: Praise; implies a gentle, flowing speech, not a loud or long-winded one. Also common is 娓娓道来.
usage.zh: 褒义，强调说话动听、从容不迫，不是啰嗦。也说“娓娓道来”。

meaning.en: To stay calm and composed as if nothing were wrong, even in a crisis.
meaning.zh: 遇到紧急情况时沉着镇静，神态像平常一样。

examples.zh: 面对记者的追问，他镇定自若。
examples.en: He stayed cool under the reporters' questions.

examples.zh: 火灾发生时，老师镇定自若，组织学生有序撤离。
examples.en: When the fire broke out, the teacher stayed calm and led the students out in order.

usage.en: Praise; usually describes a person's demeanour in a crisis. Compare 沉着冷静 (a more general phrase).
usage.zh: 褒义，多形容人在紧急关头的神态。

literal: the more · setback · the more · brave

meaning.en: To become more determined and courageous with each setback.
meaning.zh: 越是受到挫折，越是勇敢，斗志越强。

examples.zh: 他屡败屡战，愈挫愈勇，终于夺得冠军。
examples.en: Beaten again and again, he only grew bolder and finally won the title.

examples.zh: 创业路上，她愈挫愈勇。
examples.en: On her entrepreneurial road she grew more resolute with every setback.

usage.en: Praise. Do not confuse with 屡败屡战 (fail and fight on). Often written 越挫越勇 in speech.
usage.zh: 褒义。口语中也常说“越挫越勇”。

natural: be the first to open the channel

meaning.en: To be the first to do something and set a precedent for others.
meaning.zh: 比喻首先开创某种风气或做法，为后来者开路。

examples.zh: 这所大学首开先河，设立了人工智能本科专业。
examples.en: The university broke new ground by founding an undergraduate AI programme.

examples.zh: 他的小说首开先河，把科幻引入了乡土文学。
examples.en: His novel pioneered the introduction of science fiction into rural literature.

usage.en: Praise; the thing opened is a practice, genre or trend. Note 先河 means 'the source river', so it cannot be followed by a person as the object.
usage.zh: 褒义。“先河”指水源，宾语一般是风气、做法、领域，而不是人。

meaning.en: A casual remark that, unexpectedly, turns out to be a prediction of an unfortunate event.
meaning.zh: 随口说的话竟然应验了（多指不好的事）。

examples.zh: 他开玩笑说自己要迟到，没想到一语成谶，航班真的延误了。
examples.en: He joked that he would be late, and the words came true; the flight really was delayed.

examples.zh: 她赛前一句“我可能赢不了”竟一语成谶。
examples.en: Her pre-match remark, 'I might not win', turned out to be prophetic.

usage.en: Usually about an unlucky outcome that someone had mentioned lightly; not used for deliberate predictions.
usage.zh: 多指不吉利的话偶然应验，不用于有意的预言。

meaning.en: To outdo all the other contestants through superior skill.
meaning.zh: 凭借高超的技艺超过所有对手。

examples.zh: 她在决赛中技压群雄，夺得金牌。
examples.en: She outclassed the field in the final and took the gold.

examples.zh: 这位年轻厨师技压群雄，赢得了大赛冠军。
examples.en: The young chef outshone all rivals to win the competition.

usage.en: Praise for contests of skill. Compare 艳压群芳 (for beauty) and 才压群雄.
usage.zh: 褒义，多用于技艺比赛。形容容貌用“艳压群芳”。

meaning.en: Life in grave danger, hanging by a thread.
meaning.zh: 生命悬在一根线上，形容处境极其危险。

examples.zh: 伤员命悬一线，医生连夜抢救。
examples.en: The injured man's life hung by a thread, and doctors worked through the night.

examples.zh: 山体滑坡时，他们命悬一线。
examples.en: When the landslide hit, their lives hung by a thread.

usage.en: Describes danger to life. Similar to 千钧一发 but this one stresses that life itself is at stake.
usage.zh: 强调生命危险。与“千钧一发”相近，但更强调性命。

literal: store up · momentum · wait · to launch

meaning.en: To build up strength and wait for the right moment to act.
meaning.zh: 积蓄力量，等待时机行动。

examples.zh: 球队蓄势待发，准备在下半场发起反击。
examples.en: The team is poised to launch a counter-attack in the second half.

examples.zh: 新产品蓄势待发，下月将正式亮相。
examples.en: The new product is ready to go and will debut next month.

usage.en: Positive or neutral; often about teams, products and plans about to take off.
usage.zh: 偏褒义，多用于球队、产品、计划即将行动。

meaning.en: Overcome with sorrow, as at a painful parting.
meaning.zh: 形容极度悲伤、愁苦，好像灵魂离开了身体。

examples.zh: 车站送别，她黯然销魂，久久不愿离去。
examples.en: At the station she was heartbroken and long unwilling to leave.

examples.zh: 读到这首悼亡词，无人不黯然销魂。
examples.en: No one could read this elegy without being overcome with grief.

story.en: Jiang Yan's 'Rhapsody on Parting' opens with the line that nothing makes the soul more desolate than parting.

usage.en: Literary; mostly about parting or loss. Usually 黯然 alone is enough in daily speech.
usage.zh: 书面色彩浓，多用于离别或失落。

meaning.en: A woman's face turning pale with fright.
meaning.zh: 形容女子受到惊吓，脸色大变。

examples.zh: 一只老鼠窜出来，吓得她花容失色。
examples.en: A mouse darted out and she went white with fright.

examples.zh: 听到噩耗，她顿时花容失色。
examples.en: On hearing the terrible news, her face drained of colour.

usage.en: Traditionally used for women; with men it sounds jocular. It describes fear, not beauty fading.
usage.zh: 传统上多形容女子，用于男子带戏谑意味。描写惊恐，不是容貌衰老。

meaning.en: To enforce the law fairly, with no favouritism.
meaning.zh: 按公正的原则执行法律，不徇私情。

equivalents: apply the law without fear or favour

examples.zh: 法官秉公执法，不受任何人干扰。
examples.en: The judge applied the law without fear or favour, free from interference.

examples.zh: 执法人员必须秉公执法。
examples.en: Law enforcement officers must enforce the law impartially.

usage.en: A formal phrase common in news and official writing; praise for officials, judges and police.
usage.zh: 多见于新闻和公文，褒义，用于法官、警察、官员。

meaning.en: Calm and undisturbed, as water without waves; steady and uneventful.
meaning.zh: 水面没有大的波浪，比喻心情平静或事情平淡，没有大的变化。

examples.zh: 听到这个消息，他心中波澜不惊。
examples.en: On hearing the news, he stayed inwardly unruffled.

examples.zh: 几十年来，小镇的生活一直波澜不惊。
examples.en: For decades life in the little town has gone on without a ripple.

usage.en: Describes a calm mind or an uneventful life; neutral and often admiring, though it can imply dullness.
usage.zh: 形容心境平静或生活平淡，可褒可中性。

meaning.en: Having some use or benefit; helpful to a degree.
meaning.zh: 不是没有好处，指有一定的益处。

examples.zh: 多读经典，对写作不无裨益。
examples.en: Reading the classics is of some benefit to your writing.

examples.zh: 这次交流对双方都不无裨益。
examples.en: The exchange was of some benefit to both sides.

usage.en: A double negative for a modest positive (understatement); formal. Do not use for great benefit; 裨 means 'help'.
usage.zh: 双重否定，语气委婉，表示“有一些好处”，书面语。
